sloka: लङ्काविपर्ययं दृष्ट्वा यानि लङ्कालयान्यथ ।भूतानि भयदर्शीनि विमनस्कानि सर्वशः ।। ७.६.५० ॥
transliteration: laṅkāviparyayaṁ dṛṣṭvā yāni laṅkālayānyatha ।bhūtāni bhayadarśīni vimanaskāni sarvaśaḥ ।। 7.6.50 ॥

translations.english: Seeing the impending destruction of Lanka, all the beings dwelling there became utterly fearful and disheartened.
